classes.name: TFunction_Driver
classes.summary: This driver class provide services around function execution. One instance of this class is built for the whole session. The driver is bound to the DriverGUID in the DriverTable class. It allows you to create classes which inherit from this abstract class. These subclasses identify the various algorithms which can be applied to the data contained in the attributes of sub-labels of a model. A single instance of this class and each of its subclasses is built for the whole session.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.comment: Initializes the label L for this function prior to its execution.

instanceMethods.name: Label
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the label of the driver for this function.

instanceMethods.name: Validate
instanceMethods.comment:
Validates labels of a function in <log>. This function is the one initialized in this function driver. Warning In regeneration mode, the solver must call this method even if the function is not executed.
**execution of function**

instanceMethods.name: MustExecute
instanceMethods.comment: Analyzes the labels in the logbook log. Returns true if attributes have been modified. If the function label itself has been modified, the function must be executed.

instanceMethods.name: Execute
instanceMethods.comment:
Executes the function in this function driver and puts the impacted labels in the logbook log.
**arguments & results of functions**
@returns A result object with fields:
- `returnValue`: the C++ return value
- `log`: owned by the returned envelope.
Dispose the returned envelope to release owned Handle fields.

instanceMethods.name: Arguments
instanceMethods.comment:
The method fills-in the list by labels, where the arguments of the function are located.
@param args Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

instanceMethods.name: Results
instanceMethods.comment:
The method fills-in the list by labels, where the results of the function are located.
@param res Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

classes.name: TFunction_DriverTable
classes.summary: A container for instances of drivers. You create a new instance of {@link TFunction_Driver | `TFunction_Driver`} and use the method AddDriver to load it into the driver table.

staticMethods.name: Get
staticMethods.comment: Returns the driver table. If a driver does not exist, creates it.

instanceMethods.name: AddDriver
instanceMethods.signature: (guid: Standard_GUID, driver: TFunction_Driver, thread?: number): boolean
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if the driver has been added successfully to the driver table.

instanceMethods.name: HasDriver
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if the driver exists in the driver table.

instanceMethods.name: FindDriver
instanceMethods.signature: (guid: Standard_GUID, thread: number): { returnValue: boolean; driver: TFunction_Driver; [Symbol.dispose](): void }
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns true if the driver was found.
@returns A result object with fields:
- `returnValue`: the C++ return value
- `driver`: owned by the returned envelope.
Dispose the returned envelope to release owned Handle fields.

instanceMethods.name: RemoveDriver
instanceMethods.comment: Removes a driver with the given GUID. Returns true if the driver has been removed successfully.

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: Removes all drivers. Returns true if the driver has been removed successfully.

classes.name: TFunction_Function
classes.summary:
Provides the following two services.
- a link to an evaluation driver
- the means of providing a link between a function and an evaluation driver.

staticMethods.name: Set
staticMethods.comment:
**Static methods:**
Finds or Creates a function attribute on the label <L>. Returns the function attribute.

staticMethods.name: Set
staticMethods.comment: Finds or Creates a function attribute on the label <L>. Sets a driver ID to the function. Returns the function attribute.

staticMethods.name: GetID
staticMethods.comment:
Returns the GUID for functions. Returns a function found on the label.
**Instance methods:**

instanceMethods.name: GetDriverGUID
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the GUID for this function's driver.

instanceMethods.name: SetDriverGUID
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the driver for this function as that identified by the GUID guid.

instanceMethods.name: Failed
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if the execution failed.

instanceMethods.name: SetFailure
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the failed index.

instanceMethods.name: GetFailure
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns an index of failure if the execution of this function failed. If this integer value is 0, no failure has occurred.
**Implementation of Attribute methods:**

instanceMethods.name: ID
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the ID of the attribute.

instanceMethods.name: Restore
instanceMethods.comment: Restores the backuped contents from <anAttribute> into this one. It is used when aborting a transaction.

instanceMethods.name: Paste
instanceMethods.comment:
This method is different from the "Copy" one, because it is used when copying an attribute from a source structure into a target structure. This method may paste the contents of <me> into <intoAttribute>.
The given pasted attribute can be full or empty of its contents. But don't make a NEW! Just set the contents!
It is possible to use <aRelocationTable> to get/set the relocation value of a source attribute.

instanceMethods.name: NewEmpty
instanceMethods.comment: Returns an new empty attribute from the good end type. It is used by the copy algorithm.

instanceMethods.name: References
instanceMethods.comment:
Adds the first level referenced attributes and labels to <aDataSet>.
For this, use the AddLabel or AddAttribute of DataSet.
If there is none, do not implement the method.

classes.name: TFunction_IFunction

constructors.name: constructor

staticMethods.name: NewFunction
staticMethods.comment: Sets a new function attached to a label <L> with <ID>. It creates a new {@link TFunction_Function | `TFunction_Function`} attribute initialized by the <ID>, a new {@link TFunction_GraphNode | `TFunction_GraphNode`} with an empty list of dependencies and the status equal to TFunction_ES_WrongDefinition. It registers the function in the scope of functions for this document.

classes.name: TFunction_Iterator
classes.summary: {@link Iterator | `Iterator`} of the graph of functions.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.comment: Initializes the {@link Iterator | `Iterator`}.

instanceMethods.name: SetUsageOfExecutionStatus
instanceMethods.comment: Defines the mode of iteration - usage or not of the execution status. If the iterator takes into account the execution status, the method ::Current() returns only "not executed" functions while their status is not changed. If the iterator ignores the execution status, the method ::Current() returns the functions following their dependencies and ignoring the execution status.

instanceMethods.name: GetUsageOfExecutionStatus
instanceMethods.comment: Returns usage of execution status by the iterator.

instanceMethods.name: GetMaxNbThreads
instanceMethods.comment: Analyses the graph of dependencies and returns maximum number of threads may be used to calculate the model.

instanceMethods.name: Current
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the current list of functions. If the iterator uses the execution status, the returned list contains only the functions with "not executed" status.

instanceMethods.name: More
instanceMethods.comment: Returns false if the graph of functions is fully iterated.

instanceMethods.name: Next
instanceMethods.comment: Switches the iterator to the next list of current functions.

instanceMethods.name: GetStatus
instanceMethods.comment: A help-function aimed to help the user to check the status of retrurned function. It calls `TFunction_GraphNode::GetStatus()` inside.

instanceMethods.name: SetStatus
instanceMethods.comment: A help-function aimed to help the user to change the execution status of a function. It calls `TFunction_GraphNode::SetStatus()` inside.

classes.name: TFunction_Logbook
classes.summary:
This class contains information which is written and read during the solving process. Information is divided in three groups.
- Touched Labels (modified by the end user),
- Impacted Labels (modified during execution of the function),
- Valid Labels (within the valid label scope).

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment:
The methods manipulating the data (touched, impacted and valid labels).
Constructor (empty).

staticMethods.name: Set
staticMethods.comment: Finds or Creates a {@link TFunction_Logbook | `TFunction_Logbook`} attribute at the root label accessed by <Access>. Returns the attribute.

staticMethods.name: GetID
staticMethods.comment: Returns the GUID for logbook attribute.

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: Clears this logbook to its default, empty state.

instanceMethods.name: SetTouched
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the label L as a touched label in this logbook. In other words, L is understood to have been modified by the end user.

instanceMethods.name: SetImpacted
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the label L as an impacted label in this logbook. This method is called by execution of the function driver.

instanceMethods.name: SetValid
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the label L as a valid label in this logbook.

instanceMethods.name: IsModified
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the label L is touched or impacted. This method is called by <TFunction_FunctionDriver::MustExecute>. If <WithChildren> is set to true, the method checks all the sublabels of <L> too.

instanceMethods.name: GetTouched
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the map of touched labels in this logbook. A touched label is the one modified by the end user.

instanceMethods.name: GetImpacted
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the map of impacted labels contained in this logbook.

instanceMethods.name: GetValid
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the map of valid labels in this logbook.

instanceMethods.name: Done
instanceMethods.comment: Sets status of execution.

instanceMethods.name: IsDone
instanceMethods.comment: Returns status of execution.
